exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean delivery, vaginal delivery)
BMI groups (obese: BMI > 30, normal weight: BMI < 30)
outcome: VEGF expression in the umbilical cord
cohort: 109 pregnant women with a first-trimester singleton pregnancy
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with decreased VEGF expression in the umbilical cord.
mod_finding: VEGF score was highest in the vaginal delivery group and lowest in the obesity group.
